title: Relation register row
description: A lateral relationship between two hierarchy entries or nodes, read as 'from_id relation to_id'. Hierarchy itself lives in parent_id and parent_node_id, and journey versions in baseline_journey_id; neither is a relation. One CSV row is one JSON object keyed by column header; an empty cell means 'not yet known' and is omitted from the object, so 'required' means the cell must be filled. List-valued cells hold IDs separated by ';' with no spaces. Required: from_id, relation and to_id (the relationship itself; together they are the row's identity and must be unique) and evidence_status (a relationship is a claim and carries provenance). evidence_ids cites the evidence for the relationship (observed or inferred relations must cite supporting evidence); note explains it; both may be empty.

from_id.description: Hierarchy entry or node the relation starts from.

to_id.description: Hierarchy entry or node the relation points to; never equal to from_id.
